claimed_scope: Implement the smallest deterministic uninstall/disable/permission-withdrawal and state-preserving host-switch planning/validation primitive for Frankenstein 2.0. The component consumes explicit caller-supplied current host/state/permission identities and produces a typed transition plan only. It must preserve one canonical durable state lineage across host disable/uninstall/switch, forbid deletion or silent duplication of canonical state, distinguish code/adapter removal from state retirement, make permission withdrawal monotonic and explicit for affected optional capabilities, require a verified successor host route before switch completion, and preserve rollback/re-enable identity where declared. No filesystem or host mutation, no live uninstall/install, no provider/model/tool calls, no secrets, no UnifiedDB mutation, no effects, no physical-host credit and no whole-system completion. Source/tests plus repository-hosted CI only.

adapter removal never implies canonical state deletion

switch cannot mint a second canonical state lineage
permission withdrawal is explicit and blocks affected optional capabilities
state retirement requires a separate explicit destructive authority not granted here
rollback or re-enable targets bind the same state lineage when declared
repository CI validates transition logic only and cannot mint physical-host acceptance
